subject: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics

Team,

Stowbridge (contact: Daniel Warren) is confirmed to sponsor a private curated dinner we are running in NYC on Sep 15. They want a small, invite-only table (approx 18 pax) with a short 15-minute briefing from our product team. Key asks from their side:
- NDA (they prefer mutual NDA / attendee privacy clause)
- Sponsor intake details (logo placement, 2-minute intro, dietary constraints)
- Confirmation of venue logistics, AV, and estimated line-item cost for sponsorship credit approval

Venue lead is Elena Rossi at Olivo Bistro (Italian); she suggested a private dining room with a set menu. I've attached the initial sponsor intake that Daniel sent us (stowbridge_sponsor_intake.pdf).

Proposed ownership:
- Logistics & invites: Marissa
- Legal/NDA: Ben
- Sponsor commercial terms & timeline: Laura (I can support)

Please reply with any objections or alternative owners by EOD today. If we agree, Marissa — can you draft an attendee roster template and menu options? Ben — once you have the intake, can you flag any NDA items that need escalation to our legal partner?

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics

+1 on the owners. No objections.

Timeline thoughts:
- Aug 20–24: intake + NDA redline
- Aug 25–28: finalize menu & attendee list, send invites
- Sep 1: RSVP close / dietary confirmations
- Sep 8: final headcount to venue / AV run-through

Marissa — can you run a quick vendor check (insurance, liquor liability) with Elena and confirm minimum spend? Also include a 2-course tasting option attached to the invite so sponsors see the menu.

Ben — if we can get the NDA draft back early next week, we can route to Stowbridge legal and lock it in via DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Events Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Legal Ops <legal@stowbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics

Thanks — I reviewed the sponsor intake. A few items from legal:
- Stowbridge's requested mutual NDA is fine in principle, but they added an attendee privacy clause that could limit our use of contact data for follow-ups. We should propose a limited-purpose clause (sales follow-ups only) and add a 12-month retention cap.
- Request redlines to the confidentiality definition (too broad) and an explicit carve-out for aggregated, de-identified insights.

I've attached a redline (Stowbridge_NDA_redline.docx). I'll take primary on negotiations with their counsel but would like a quick sync if they push back on the retention language.

I'll prepare a clean DocuSign-ready PDF once we land language.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Legal Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Warren <daniel.warren@stowbridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@stowbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics

Hi Priyom / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Stowbridge is excited to participate. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We prefer a mutual NDA but would like the attendee privacy clause to cover "no public distribution of attendee emails or logos" — we can accept a 12-month retention limit but will need a carve-out for post-event follow-up directly related to business opportunities (introductions, follow-up meetings).
- Attached is our W-9 and initial sponsor intake (for reference).

On logistics: we prefer a seating map that separates partner sponsors from customers; feeding preferences below (we will send a full list when you request final RSVPs).

Best,
Daniel Warren
Head of Platform Partnerships
Stowbridge Capital
Attachments: w9_stowbridge.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Daniel Warren <daniel.warren@stowbridge.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@olivobistro.it>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Draft attendee list + menu options (v1)

Attached are two items: attendee_list_v1.csv (draft roster with titles/company) and menu_tasting.pdf (2-course tasting and vegetarian/gluten-free alternatives). Elena — can you confirm the private room set for 18 and whether the tasting menu requires a $1,200 food & beverage minimum? Also confirm AV laptop/projector availability and whether we can run a short mic for the 15-minute product intro.

Daniel — the roster is intentionally light on sponsor contacts; when you share final RSVPs we will merge. Please flag any high-sensitivity attendees you want anonymized on the guest list.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events Coordinator
Redwood Inference
Attachments: attendee_list_v1.csv, menu_tasting.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Daniel Warren <daniel.warren@stowbridge.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@olivobistro.it>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private curated table — sponsor onboarding, NDAs, and logistics

All — solid progress, thank you. Quick summary / next steps: 
1) Ben: finalize NDA redline today and prepare DocuSign link (we'll accept Stowbridge carve-out for intro follow-ups but keep the 12-month retention cap).
2) Laura: confirm sponsorship credit line and any billing steps required by finance (we may need a short SOW).
3) Marissa: confirm venue minimum, AV mic/laptop, and send final invite template by Aug 26.
4) Daniel / Stowbridge: please send final RSVP list by Sep 1 and flag any attendees you want anonymized.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 20-minute pre-event ops call on Sep 9. If anyone sees a blocker, flag it here.

Best,
Priyom
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
